talent_changes.change: All totems 1.0 s GCD (was 1.5); persistent-buff totems last 5 min (was 2); new totem tracking UI (right-click to dismiss); resistance totems affect the whole raid.
Weapon imbues last 60 min (was 5) and can be active alongside sharpening stones, weightstones and wizard oil.
Fire Nova Totem removed, replaced by the baseline Fire Nova spell (erupts at your current Fire totem, repeatable). Tranquil Air Totem removed.
Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem became party-wide buffs; a Shaman with the matching imbue could not benefit (SUPERSEDED by the Nov 10/11 hotfix).
New: Totemic Recall (20), Call of the Elements (20), Call of the Spirits (30), Call of the Ancestors (40), Totemic Projection (22, 1 min cooldown, 25% base mana; became Totemic Call at launch).

Elemental Mastery removed; Lightning Mastery renamed Elemental Alacrity and moved up; Lightning Overload, Earthbound (21-pt) and Lava Burst (31-pt) added. Lava Burst was later removed before launch (Nov 2).

Stormstrike moved to the 16-point gold medal, 8 s cooldown (was 20), buffs your next Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning/Earth Shock by 20%. New: Shamanistic Focus (11-pt), Mental Dexterity, Mental Quickness, Improved Stormstrike, Maelstrom Weapon, Rage of the Farseer (31-pt, personal cooldown inspired by Heroism/Bloodlust). Spirit Weapons replaces Parry. Shield Specialization removed; Enhancing Totems, Two-Handed Axes and Maces, Weapon Mastery and Improved Weapon Totems baseline.
New: Mindfulness, Water Shield (11-pt), Riptide (31-pt). Mana Tide Totem moves to the 16-pt medal. Healing Way redesigned (% to Healing Wave). Restorative Totems doubled. Nature's Guidance removed.

Flametongue Totem no longer stacks with Flametongue Weapon or Windfury Totem; Tranquil Air, Windfury and Grace of Air Totems no longer stack even from different Shamans. Rage of the Far Seer no longer increases spell casting speed. Riptide can crit.

Grace of Air Totem no longer exclusive with Windfury/Flametongue Totem (those two stay exclusive). Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue Totems are raid-wide. Grounding Totem destroyed after redirecting a spell.
Chain Lightning mana -35%; Fire Nova coefficient 0.143, base damage and mana cost significantly reduced; Stormstrike costs 8% of base mana.
Mana Tide Totem gains a rank at 38 (ranks at 25, 38, 48, 58). Water Shield triggers from any spell crit. Tidal Focus moves to row 1, Totemic Focus to row 2.
Elemental Mastery returns as the 31-point medal; Earthbound moves to the 16-point medal; Call of Flame extends Flame Shock by 3/6/9 s.
Totemic Projection renamed Totemic Call: teleports your totems to your own location; cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (cooldown is a recorded conflict).
Lightning Bolt base damage raised at all ranks; Chain Lightning 2.5 s cast, ~145% of comparable Lightning Bolt damage, ~225% of its mana; Shock base damage reverted to Classic Era values.
Lava Burst removed, replaced by Call of Thunder (+5% crit to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning). Lightning Overload 10/20/30%. Elemental Mastery renamed Lightning Mastery.

Improved Ghost Wolf moved to row 4; Maelstrom Weapon chance doubled; Stormstrike 150% normalized weapon damage, 6 s cooldown; Mental Dexterity 50/100/150%; Flurry 6/12/18/24/30% (Stormstrike, Maelstrom and Mental Dexterity values SUPERSEDED by the Nov 10/11 hotfix).
Riptide: mana cost about 40% lower, cooldown 12 s (was 6 s), no initial heal (HoT only). Riptide numbers remain a recorded conflict.
Lightning Mastery visual updated; Lightning Overload deals the correct Lightning Bolt damage.
Improved Ghost Wolf holds the Night Watchman's Torch correctly.
Weapon imbues and weapon totems can be used at the same time (Windfury Weapon + Windfury Totem both proc). Flametongue Totem Rank 2 fixed (Nov 11).

Stormstrike 100% weapon damage (was 150%), 8 s cooldown (was 6 s). Mental Dexterity 33/66/100% (was 50/100/150%). Maelstrom Weapon 20% cast time and mana per stack at all ranks; 6/7/8/9/10 procs per minute by rank (was 20); tooltip shows % chance from main-hand speed (5/5 + 3.6 speed = 60%). Maelstrom trackable in the Cooldown Manager. Dev note: Windfury should stay at the heart of Enhancement; move off Spell Power/Intellect gear before raids.
Windfury Totem is activated by all melee abilities' main-hand strikes, even ones not using the main-hand weapon; off-hand strikes still do not proc it.

rotations.enhancement: Before combat: Windfury Weapon (from 30; before that Rockbiter Weapon solo, Flametongue Weapon in groups), Lightning Shield (or Water Shield if talented), totems: Strength of Earth Totem, Magma Totem (Searing Totem if mana is short), Mana Spring Totem, Windfury Totem (it now stacks with your own Windfury Weapon, so drop it even solo). Single target: Magma Totem if not active (Searing Totem if mana is limited) > Flame Shock if missing on the target > Rage of the Farseer (with trinkets and racials such as Berserking) > Stormstrike on cooldown (8 s; react to Improved Stormstrike resets) > Lightning Bolt only at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks (instant, does not reset the swing timer; never below 5) > Earth Shock (spends the Stormstrike debuff; Frost Shock if threat is a problem) > Fire Nova with a Fire totem active. AoE: Magma Totem > Fire Nova on cooldown > Flame Shock cycling targets > Rage of the Farseer > Stormstrike > Lightning Bolt at 5 stacks > Earth Shock. Leveling before talents: pull with rank 1 Lightning Bolt, Earth Shock on cooldown (it also interrupts), Fire Nova with a Fire totem and spare mana, then auto-attack; Healing Wave after pulls, Lesser Healing Wave when in danger; Ghost Wolf between fights from 20.
rotations.elemental: Pre-place totems (Call of the Elements; drop Searing Totem last for single target, Magma Totem for 3+ targets). Single target: Flame Shock, refresh when it falls off > Lightning Mastery with racials, potions and trinkets > Chain Lightning outside the Lightning Mastery window (in long fights only with Clearcasting) > Lightning Bolt as filler. 3+ targets: Lightning Mastery > Chain Lightning on cooldown > Fire Nova on cooldown > Flame Shock on targets without it > Lightning Bolt (skip Flame Shock and Lightning Bolt if mana will not last). Leveling: Lightning Shield between pulls (Water Shield once talented), open from max range with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, Fire Nova from 12 and Chain Lightning from 32 for packs, Earth Shock to interrupt casters.
rotations.restoration: Water Shield (Lightning Shield before you have it) and totems before the pull. Single target: Riptide on the most injured target on cooldown > Healing Wave (downrank when damage is light) > Lightning Bolt for damage only when no healing is needed. Group damage: Riptide > Chain Heal on an injured target with Riptide > Fire Nova and Chain Lightning only if mana allows. Nature's Swiftness + Healing Wave for emergencies; Mana Tide Totem at about 80% mana. Earth Shock is the only healer interrupt. Not recommended for solo leveling (play Enhancement solo).
rotations.mana: Spirit-based mana regen pauses for 5 s after you spend any mana, including instants and totems. Let auto-attacks finish low targets instead of a last spell; refresh Lightning Shield right after the last spell of a fight; stop casting and let mana build when safe. In-combat regen: Improved Stormstrike (50% regen while casting for 15 s after Stormstrike), Mindfulness (50% while casting), Water Shield (2% of max mana per globe). Mana Spring Totem for the group. Totemic Recall refunds 25% of your totems' mana; Call of the Elements costs all four totems at once; Totemic Call is very expensive and on the GCD, so usually recall and re-drop instead. Spend Clearcasting on expensive spells (Chain Lightning, Fire Nova). A Paladin's Judgement of Wisdom carries Enhancement mana in groups. Always carry water.
rotations.imbues: Nov 10/11 hotfix first: weapon imbues and weapon totems now stack (Windfury Weapon + Windfury Totem both proc), and Blizzard wants Windfury at the heart of Enhancement. Enhancement: Windfury Weapon from 30, always (Icy Veins Nov 13: the go-to imbue; Flametongue builds are unlikely to compete). Before 30: Rockbiter Weapon solo, Flametongue Weapon in groups. Elemental/Restoration: Flametongue Weapon (Wowhead leveling pages, pre-hotfix). Imbues last 60 min and sit alongside stones and oils.
rotations.totems: One totem per element; 1.0 s GCD; buff totems last 5 min. Enhancement: Strength of Earth Totem, Magma Totem (Searing Totem if mana-limited), Mana Spring Totem, Windfury Totem. Casters in groups: Strength of Earth Totem and Windfury Totem with melee, Searing Totem (Magma Totem vs 3+), Mana Spring Totem; Grace of Air Totem with other Shamans. Fire Nova needs an active Fire totem near the enemies. Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem are exclusive. Grounding Totem vs casters, Tremor Totem vs fear/charm/sleep, Poison Cleansing Totem / Disease Cleansing Totem when needed, Earthbind Totem to kite, Stoneclaw Totem to soak an extra mob. Totemic Recall when moving on.

totem_rules.text: One totem of each element at a time; each element needs its totem item (Earth/Fire/Water/Air Totem) in your bags. Totems are stationary (most have 5 health) and affect allies within 30 yd of the totem.
totem_rules.tracking_ui: Blizzard's built-in totem tracker shows active totems and time left; right-click dismisses one. The addon must not fight it.
totem_rules.call_of_the_elements: Level 20: unlocks the totem bar; drops your 4 preset totems after a 3 s cast for their combined mana. Call of the Spirits and Call of the Ancestors add presets 2 and 3 (levels conflict: 30/40 deep dive vs 40/30 endgametools).
totem_rules.totemic_recall: Level 20: destroys your totems and refunds 25% of their mana; off the GCD (Icy Veins).
totem_rules.totemic_call: Level 22 (was Totemic Projection): moves your active totems to you. 25% of base mana, on the GCD. Cooldown CONFLICT: 30 s (Blizzard Nov 2 notes, foreverguide, endgametools) vs 1 minute (deep dive as Totemic Projection, Wowhead Restoration overview). Do not hard-code.
totem_rules.fire_nova: Baseline spell from 12 that erupts at your active Fire totem (10 s cooldown, 6 s with Trial by Fire); needs a Fire totem near the enemies.
totem_rules.exclusivity: Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem do not stack for the party. Weapon imbues and weapon totems stack since the Nov 10/11 hotfix. Grace of Air vs Windfury exclusivity is a recorded conflict.

pvp.summary: World PvP for a Shaman: no hard crowd control, so you win with interrupts (Earth Shock), slows (Frost Shock, Earthbind Totem), Purge and the right totem. On a PvP ruleset you're flagged in contested and enemy zones (any zone above level 15 is contested, Icy Veins).

realm_detection.text: No source documents an in-game API that returns the Forever ruleset (Normal/PvP/RP/Hardcore). C_GameRules.GetActiveGameMode exists in the Forever client but returns Enum.GameMode (Standard/Plunderstorm/WoWHack), not the ruleset. A code search of Ketho/wow-ui-source-forever for Ruleset/GetRuleSet/IsPvPRealm/GetServerPVPType found only chat-channel, spell-diminish and login-screen (waitingForRuleSets, superDistrict) uses; nothing an addon can query in-world. Icy Veins: rulesets replace realm types; PvP ruleset auto-flags you in Contested/Enemy zones (any zone above level 15 is contested), others need /pvp. Practical options: parse GetRealmName() (observed ids like ...Realm6PvP) or infer from UnitIsPVP('player') while in a contested zone without having typed /pvp; both are undocumented heuristics.
realm_detection.addon_rule: GetRealmName() ending in 'PvP' counts as the PvP ruleset (suggest PvP mode once); ending in 'PvE' counts as Normal; anything else: manual switch. Observed ids: CAMWOWUS2Realm1PvE (Normal ruleset, Tazu's realm) and CAMWOWUS2Realm6PvP (a PvP-ruleset realm), from StoryTracker's GetRealmName() keys on TUF, 2026-11-25.
realm_detection.flag: No documented ruleset API; the realm-id suffix is an observed, undocumented pattern.

totem_picks.name: Grounding Totem
totem_picks.what: 5 hp totem; redirects one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 s. Not AoE spells. Lasts 45 s, 15 s cooldown, 6% base mana.
totem_picks.pvp_use: Vs casters: eats one harmful spell. Save it for the one that matters.

totem_picks.name: Tremor Totem
totem_picks.what: 5 hp totem; removes Fear, Charm and Sleep from party members within 30 yd. Lasts 5 min, no cooldown, 60 mana.
totem_picks.pvp_use: Vs fear: frees you and your party from Fear, Charm and Sleep.
totem_picks.flag: Pulse interval not in Forever tooltip; Icy Veins Elemental/Resto leveling say every 2 s, Enhancement leveling says every 5 s.

totem_picks.name: Earthbind Totem
totem_picks.what: 5 hp totem for 45 s; Earthbind slows enemies within 10 yd by 50% (5 s debuff, refreshed). 15 s cooldown, 6% base mana. Elemental talent Earthbound (Icy Veins: level 25 pick) makes it root for 5 s.
totem_picks.pvp_use: For kiting: slows melee 50% so you can get away (roots with Earthbound).

tips.title: Earth Shock to interrupt
tips.body: Earth Shock interrupts a cast and locks that spell school for 2 s. Save it for heals or big casts. All Shocks share a 6 s cooldown, so each Shock has an opportunity cost.

tips.title: Frost Shock to kite
tips.body: Frost Shock slows the target 50% for 8 s. Use it to kite melee or stop a runner.

tips.title: Grounding vs casters
tips.body: Grounding Totem (30) redirects one harmful spell aimed at you or your party (every 10 s, not AoE). Icy Veins: great vs spellcasters.

tips.title: Tremor vs fear
tips.body: Tremor Totem (18) removes Fear, Charm and Sleep from party within 30 yd. Skill Capped: use it to get your healer out of Fear.

tips.title: Earthbind to escape
tips.body: Earthbind Totem slows enemies within 10 yd by 50%; with the Earthbound talent it roots for 5 s. Good for escaping melee.

tips.title: Purge their buffs
tips.body: Purge removes a magic buff (rank 1: one effect). Strip shields (Mage, Priest) and heal-over-time effects.

tips.title: Ghost Wolf to run
tips.body: Ghost Wolf (20) gives +40% run speed with no cooldown. Improved Ghost Wolf makes it instant.
tips.flag: Icy Veins frames it as travel/mobility, not explicitly a PvP escape.

tips.title: Stoneform vs melee and DoTs
tips.body: Stoneform removes and blocks Poison, Bleed and Disease and cuts Physical damage 10% for 8 s. Icy Veins: nice vs melee; the cleanse helps in 1v1.

tips.title: Lesser Healing Wave for fast heals
tips.body: In PvP, heal with Lesser Healing Wave (1.5 s cast) rather than slow Healing Wave; use Nature's Swiftness for an instant big heal.
tips.flag: Classic (not Forever) Icy Veins PvP guide.

tips.title: No real CC: lean on utility
tips.body: Shaman lacks a Polymorph/Sap/Fear equivalent; win with slows, interrupts, Purge and totems.
tips.flag: Skill Capped is a third-party site, not on the preferred list.
